hook.prompt: How much would self-hosting our CI runners cost compared to a managed runner?

hook.last_assistant_message:
**Short answer:** use a managed runner. It saves most of the cost with almost no upkeep.

## Options at your volume

| Option | Bill per month | Setup | Upkeep |
|---|---|---|---|
| GitHub-hosted (today) | ~$340 | none | none |
| Managed runner | ~$60–150 | half a day | none |
| Self-hosted | ~$150–250 | 2–4 days | a few hours a month |

Self-hosting only pays off at roughly ten times this volume.

## Plan

1. **Today:** fix the billing card and set a budget with an alert at 75%.
2. **This week:** one PR that moves the jobs to a managed runner and runs only the affected tests on main.

Should I start that PR now, so it's ready when billing is fixed?

Linear: no change this turn. ACM-31 is still In Progress and waiting on the billing fix.

Sources: [GitHub Actions pricing](https://docs.github.com/en/billing/managing-billing-for-your-products/managing-billing-for-github-actions/about-billing-for-github-actions)

The third-party runner prices come from sources that don't fully agree, so check the vendor's own page before switching.
